mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 2% in the month preceding the prediction is associated with a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to tightened financing conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.0% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS > 2.0% periods

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment claims (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in consumer demand indicators (HOUST) predict negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns as labor market weakness dampens corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while HOUST decreases in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >70% of such labor signal events

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2% suggests accelerating supply-side momentum, which is associated with positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite INDPRO growth >2% over the next 3 months

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below the prior quarter's median triggers a positive S&P 500 5-day forward return as market anticipates deflation risk and rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below Q1 median in the current month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during such CPIAUCSL declines

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising unemployment (PAYEMS) and falling inflation (CPIAUCSL) with the Federal Funds rate held steady suggest a shift to neutral policy, predicting a positive S&P 20-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rising, CPIAUCSL falling, FEDFUNDS flat for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during such policy patterns

mechanism_narrative: A sudden jump in job openings (not directly observable in the provided proxies) would typically be associated with a positive signal, but here we proxy with a sharp drop in UNRATE below 6%, predicting a negative 60-day forward return due to labor market tightness.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 6.0% in the current month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative in >80% of UNRATE < 6% events

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in manufacturing activity (GDPC1) above 3% suggests robust demand, which is expected to drive positive S&P 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive despite GDPC1 growth >3% over the next quarter

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in RSAFS exceeds +10% (indicating accelerated credit growth), the S&P 5-day forward return is predicted to be negative due to over-lending risk.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative in >50% of such RSAFS events
